NPC-HUD mockups 2 to 4: the HUD

1. The one-page NPC sheet2 to 4. The HUD5. The bottom of the screen

One HUD for PCs and NPCs, in the pick bar's look (the dark bar, the gold line), with the Action card's amber Version buttons. No Health, AP, Guard or uses: only a used or locked Action is dimmed. Click a Version button: the roll dialog on that Version. Right-click: the Action card. The bars below are drawn at the width they would have on a 1600 px wide screen (1276 px between the left edge and the sidebar) unless a line says otherwise.
